code_events.event:
Called when formatting the field to be displayed in the Active Filters.

Callback signature:

\AL\FilterFramework\ContentTypeProviderInterface $contentTypeProvider, \XF\CustomField\Definition $fieldDefinition, array $filterData, string &$template, string &$phrase, array &$phraseParams, array &$templateParams, bool &$showLabel

Arguments:

  1. \AL\FilterFramework\ContentTypeProviderInterface $contentTypeProvider - An object representing the content type provider from an add-on.
  2. \XF\CustomField\Definition $fieldDefinition - Field definition.
  3. array $filterData - The filter data for the field with values for all active custom field filters.
  4. string &$template - The name of the template to be used to render the active filter.
  5. string &$phrase - The phrase key to be used to render the active filter.
  6. array &$phraseParams - The parameters to be used to render the phrase.
  7. array &$templateParams - The parameters to be used to render the template.
  8. bool &$showLabel - A reference to a boolean value indicating whether the label should be shown.

Called to configure filterable lists in the framework based on the field definition and API URL.

Callback signature:

\XF\CustomField\Definition $field, &$filterableListApi

Arguments:

  1. \XF\CustomField\Definition $field - Field definition used to determine the configuration of filterable lists.
  2. &$filterableListApi - A reference to the API URL string for loading filterable options. Filterable lists are not enabled if this variable is not populated by the listener.

Note:

Populate &$filterableListApi within the callback with the API URL to enable filterable lists based on the provided field definition.

If enabled, the choices will be filtered to active choices only to decrease the number of options loaded. Should be enabled by add-ons only when Filterable Lists are enabled.

Callback signature:

\XF\CustomField\Definition $definition, &$enabled

Arguments:

  1. \XF\CustomField\Definition $definition - The field definition for which the filter is being applied.
  2. &$enabled - A reference to a boolean value, indicating whether the active choices filter should be enabled.

Note:

Set &$enabled to true within the callback to enable filtering to active choices only based on the field definition.

Called when a field is being formatted for display in the framework.

Callback signature:

\AL\FilterFramework\ContentTypeProviderInterface $contentTypeProvider, \XF\CustomField\Definition $field, $value, &$formattedValue

Arguments:

  1. \AL\FilterFramework\ContentTypeProviderInterface $contentTypeProvider - An object representing the content type provider from an add-on.
  2. \XF\CustomField\Definition $field - Field definition.
  3. $value - The original value of the field.
  4. &$formattedValue - A reference to the value that will be displayed. Set to any non-null value to skip default processing.
